tasks.short: Confirm the procedure for a packaging waste route

steps.what: Submit material, market and intended route
Confirm the procedure for this pack route
Draft the route card from that procedure

loop.input: confirmed procedure id and the submitted route
loop.output: card that cites that procedure id and route only
loop.check: The card names the same procedure id and the same route the specialist confirmed
loop.stop: If the procedure id is empty, return an empty card and stop
loop.why_not_simpler: The short instruction still depends on the confirmed procedure text, not on the material name

steps.what: Publish only the signed route card
Update the pack list from the card

tasks.design: The project lead submits pack id, material, market and the route, meaning collection, reuse, recovery or recycling, on a {WORKFLOW} form. The specialist confirms the procedure. A bounded card in {DOCS} cites only that procedure id, and only the signed card is published.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pack questions arrived as material names, so a card could not show which route and which procedure the specialist had confirmed.
tasks.enabler_now: The request can store material, market and one route as fields, and the procedure can be a confirmed id rather than a paragraph copied from somewhere else.
tasks.still_hard: Which procedure applies to this pack and market is confirmed by the specialist. A material name does not select it.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist confirms the procedure and signs the card. A missing procedure id leaves the card unpublished.

ambition.what: Set the pack route before the pack is ordered, not after the first shipment

tasks.altitude: The specialist stops rewriting route descriptions and keeps the confirmation. Staff see the signed card only, and an unconfirmed pack stays off the list.

reach.task: Update the pack list from the signed card
reach.learn: Which route is signed and which pack is still waiting on a procedure

evidence.claim: The applicable procedure is confirmed by the specialist for the pack, the route and the market. This task names no instrument.
Digest [S27] says a consultancy partly repaid a public report that cited sources that did not exist, so the card must not cite a procedure the specialist did not confirm.
Packaging-route work in a mid-size firm is mostly gathering material and market facts. The procedure call itself is not a standard screen.

assumptions: Focal role is the regulatory affairs specialist. The task ends when the signed route card is published. Contracting a collector is out of scope.

Input contract: pack id, material, market, route (collection, reuse, recovery or recycling), confirmed procedure id, procedure text the specialist accepts. Producer of the pack facts is the project lead. If the procedure id is empty, the draft stops and nothing is published.

Configure the pack form and the document template before custom code. Do not keep a table that turns a material name into a legal route. The route words are the task's own categories, not a threshold.
unknowns: Which markets this firm packs for.
Whether one pack can have two routes.
Who may sign a card when the specialist is absent.
research_questions: What share of packs arrive with a route already chosen?
How often is a signed card revised because the market was wrong?

already_counted.description: Confirming the procedure stays with the specialist
Specialist edits a card that cites the wrong procedure

incremental.description: Adjust the route form when a pack can legitimately carry two routes
Quality reviewers correct a pack row that missed the signed route

approvals.approved_version: route card version signed for this pack id
the same signed route card version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes pack facts arrive as free text without a route, so the card is not drafted and the specialist still writes the answer. The high case assumes the form is complete but the procedure confirmation and the signature stay manual. Collector contracts are not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct laboratory sample collection for an agency

steps.what: State the lot, test, quantity and deadline
Match the request to the lot record
Sign the collection order for this request
Collect and prepare the named samples
Check the labels, count and condition
Sign the handover to the agency
File only the signed handover note

tasks.design: The agency reviewer sends product id, lot, test, quantity, deadline and destination by {EMAIL}. The specialist signs a collection order on the {WORKFLOW} form. The lab lead collects and prepares the samples in person. The specialist signs the handover, and only that note is filed in {DOCS}. The samples themselves are never a generated record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agency requests arrived as letters with an unclear lot, so the lab could not see a single signed list of what to take.
tasks.enabler_now: The request can store lot, test, quantity and deadline as fields the order can repeat without retyping the letter.
tasks.still_hard: Collecting and preparing the samples is physical work, and the specialist still has to check the set before anything goes to the agency.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist signs what may be collected and signs the handover. The lab lead handles the samples. A draft does not describe sample contents.
tasks.altitude: The letter is matched to a lot before the lab starts. Collection, preparation and the check of the set stay in person, and nothing is sent on an unsigned handover.

reach.task: Collect and prepare only the units named on the signed order
reach.learn: Which request is signed, which units were checked, and whether the handover was filed

evidence.claim: Directing an agency sample in a mid-size firm is coordination around physical collection. The samples are taken by hand, and the paperwork is the smaller part.
The request from the agency is the source of what to collect. This task does not name a sampling rule, and sample contents are not sent to a draft.

assumptions: Focal role is the regulatory affairs specialist. The task is directing collection and preparation. The lab lead does the physical work. Testing the sample is out of scope.

Input contract: request id, product id, lot, test name, quantity, deadline, destination, unit ids once collected. Producer of the request is the agency reviewer. A request with no lot is not turned into an order until the specialist resolves the lot by hand. Sample results and sample contents are not inputs to any draft.

Configure the order form in the existing workflow tool before custom code. The prior workflow share fits the paperwork, not the bench. Collection stays in person because the lab has no job interface for taking a sample.
unknowns: Whether the agency accepts a filed note or also wants a paper copy with the samples.
Who may sign a handover when the specialist is absent.
Whether the lot record is in the operations system or only on the batch documents.
research_questions: What share of agency requests arrive without a lot?
How often does the specialist's check reject the prepared set?

already_counted.description: The bench check of the prepared set stays with the specialist
Signing the collection order stays with the specialist

incremental.description: Adjust the order form when an agency asks for a new test field
Lab leads re-prepare a set the specialist rejected

approvals.approved_version: collection order version signed for this request id
handover note version signed for this request id
the same signed handover note version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes requests lack a lot, so the order is not generated and the specialist still directs from the letter. The high case assumes the lot matches but collection, the bench check and both signatures stay manual. Laboratory testing is not treated as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Pack records become a signed route card, while a sample day stays on the floor with the lab lead and the specialist still checks the set.
reach: Quality reviewers set the pack route from the signed card, not from a mail thread.
The lab lead collects only what the signed order names, and the agency receives the signed handover note.
skills_to_grow: Describe a pack by material, market and route before asking which procedure applies.
Direct a sample from the agency request without sending the sample contents to a draft.
role.ambitious_version: Each pack has one signed route, and an agency sample leaves only against a signed order and a signed handover.
